newsitem.title: UK: LPC - RBS backs Dixon Motors acquisition.
newsitem.headline: LPC - RBS backs Dixon Motors acquisition.

text.p: LONDON, Aug 5 (LPC) - Royal Bank of Scotland is providing in excess of 60 million stg to support Dixon Motors Plc 13.4 million stg purchase of the Carnell Motor Group, the bank announced.

The funding package, which is underwritten by RBS, comprises overdraft facilities, a bridging loan to cover a 17.6 million stg rights issue, a loan note guarantee and a 50 million stg revolving credit.

Yorkshire-based Dixon Motors is one of the UK's top 30 motor groups, while Carnell is one of the UK's largest motorcycle retailers. Incorporating sites acquired from Carnell will give Dixon Motors a total of 44 retail outlets.

Under the acquisition agreement, Dixon will repay Carnell's outstanding debt, of 10.5 million stg as of June 30, 1997, and gearing for the enlarged group will be reduced to about 40 per cent after the acquisition and rights issue. The credit will be sold down in general syndication next month. Paul Caine LPC Newsroom 44-0171-542-4048
